name: Ground Turkey Taco Stuffed Peppers
ingredients_verbatim: 3 tbsp olive oil (divided: 2 tbsp and 1 tbsp)
why: Mid-band and high protein: 438 cal, 32.2g protein, 13.7g carbs per serving on the source's own numbers. Oven-baked stuffed peppers (bake to soften, fill, bake to melt cheese) - true bake, no skillet. Every ingredient maps to the board (bell-peppers, olive-oil, sea-salt, red-onion, ground-turkey, taco-seasoning, diced-tomatoes, shredded-cheese); zero unmapped. Scales cleanly to 14 by count of peppers, weigh-and-divide filling. Distinct from existing turkey-taco-casserole/turkey-stuffed-pepper-soup and the turkey-unstuffed-pepper-skillet candidate.
